## Vocabulary

- **self**: Salesforce CDC custom-channel filters and field enrichment (17/2)

## Structure and components

- [statement] Explicit enrichment supplies otherwise unchanged context for update and delete events. Create and undelete events already contain populated fields. Empty enriched values appear as null in Pub/Sub API, while CometD and event relays omit them. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-enrich-intro.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC custom-channel filters and field enrichment

## How it works

- [statement] Fields referenced in a filter are automatically enriched. Filtered fields can be present even when unchanged, so receiving their values does not establish a transition. (high confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filters.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC custom-channel filters and field enrichment · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filter-subscribe.html
- [statement] Enrichment is not a historical snapshot: replay retrieves enriched fields from the database, so unchanged enriched values can reflect later updates. When an enriched field was changed in the original event, its changed value remains the event value. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-enrich-considerations.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC custom-channel filters and field enrichment
- [statement] Pub/Sub consumers must decode header bitmaps against the event schema. Unchanged fields can have empty payload values even when populated in Salesforce; use changedFields and nulledFields to distinguish changes and explicit nulls. (high confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/event-deserialization-considerations.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC custom-channel filters and field enrichment · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-enrich-intro.html

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] Configure a CDC channel and channel member with Tooling API; the channel uses channelType=data, and the member selects the change-event entity and filter. Salesforce recommends a custom channel to isolate the filtered stream. (high confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filter-tooling-api-add-filter.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC custom-channel filters and field enrichment · also: https://www.outofmemo.com/articles/salesforce-create-filtered-cdc-channel-platformeventchannel

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Header arrays cannot be used in channel filters, including changedFields, recordIds, nulledfields and diffFields. A subscriber can instead use changedFields to determine which fields changed. (high confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filters.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC custom-channel filters and field enrichment · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-enrich-intro.html
- [statement] Subscribe to the custom data channel topic. Stream filtering supports Pub/Sub API and CometD clients; Apex triggers cannot subscribe to filtered channel streams. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filter-subscribe.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC custom-channel filters and field enrichment

## Facts and statements

- [statement] A channel can have multiple members with individual filters. Filtering tests record state: another field update can still be delivered while the record continues to match. Do not interpret a value predicate as an interested-field-change detector. (high confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filters.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC custom-channel filters and field enrichment · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filter-subscribe.html
- [statement] Filter expressions support a subset of SOQL operators and field types; arbitrary SOQL expressions must not be assumed valid. Formula fields and long, rich or encrypted TextArea fields are unsupported. (high confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filter-expression-format.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC custom-channel filters and field enrichment · also: https://www.outofmemo.com/articles/salesforce-create-filtered-cdc-channel-platformeventchannel
- [statement] Salesforce Bolt describes custom filters as triggering on specific field changes. Salesforce documentation excludes changedFields from predicates, and its example delivers an update to another field while the record still matches. Treat the tutorial wording as broader than the documented capability. (high confidence) — https://www.salesforcebolt.com/2023/06/change-data-capture-cdc-advance.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC custom-channel filters and field enrichment · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filters.html, https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filter-subscribe.html
- [statement] Subscribe to a filtered custom channel using /data/ChannelName__chn. Stream filtering supports Pub/Sub API and CometD clients. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filter-subscribe.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC custom-channel filters and field enrichment
- [statement] Salesforce recommends a custom channel to isolate the filtered stream from the standard event stream. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filter-tooling-api-add-filter.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC custom-channel filters and field enrichment
- [statement] For enriched fields that have an empty value, Pub/Sub API clients receive null values. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-enrich-intro.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC custom-channel filters and field enrichment
- [statement] Consumers must distinguish enrichment from changes: use the changedFields header to identify changed fields. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-enrich-intro.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC custom-channel filters and field enrichment
- [statement] Filter expressions support a subset of SOQL operators and field types; do not assume arbitrary SOQL is valid. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filter-expression-format.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC custom-channel filters and field enrichment
- [statement] Formula fields are unsupported in CDC filter expressions. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filter-expression-format.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC custom-channel filters and field enrichment
- [statement] Kapil’s Salesforce Bolt tutorial demonstrates defining a CDC custom channel with channelType data and a member with an enrichedFields entry; Salesforce documents data as the change-event channel type. (medium confidence) — https://www.salesforcebolt.com/2023/06/change-data-capture-cdc-advance.html · keywords: Salesforce CDC custom-channel filters and field enrichment · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filter-tooling-api-add-filter.html

## Research summary — Salesforce CDC custom-channel filters and field enrichment

Custom CDC channels select event streams with per-member filters and add unchanged context through field enrichment. For case alerting, a matching record-state predicate does not prove that the relevant field changed. Consumers must distinguish changed fields from enriched values and interpret Pub/Sub nulls using header metadata. Replayed enrichment can reflect current database values rather than the original event state. Filter syntax and field-type restrictions constrain what can be selected on the server.
